scope: Dedicated typed vocabulary, shared practice navigation and connected learning records.

catalogue.meaning: Entry counts are not claims of distinct concepts or CEFR mastery.

connectedTo: personal saved words including grammar terms
practice XP without duplicate matching IDs

preservation: All old course word IDs and version-one backups stay valid.
Vocabulary and Games keep separate active drafts.
Hints and first mistakes cannot be rewritten as independent successes.
Concurrent changes to the same typed round require explicit profile conflict resolution.
Same-day conflicting weekly outcomes are reported as ambiguous rather than assigned invented accuracy.
maintenance: Retain supplemental grammar/noun IDs in lookup when later expanding the main vocabulary library; existing saved rounds and review records use those IDs.
limits: Internal automated checks and simulated learner journeys, not a learning-outcome study.
Browser mobile layouts and reduced viewport height approximate physical phones and keyboards.
A finite authored answer list is not a general Italian translator.
